title: Private Room at the Garden #1
description:
*This rental is for 30+ day rentals only.*

This private room is in a charming home, part of the historic Brooklyn Heights neighborhood in Nashville, TN - located 5 minutes from downtown Nashville. During your stay, you'll be surrounded by the vibrant Brooklyn Heights Community Garden (BHCG), an urban farm located on this property and across the street. The mission of BHCG is to cultivate healthy community through growing food, intergenerational learning, and creative play. Come stay a while!

The space
There are three private rooms available with a separate, shared bathroom to be used by guests only. This bedroom includes one double bed. Common areas include the living room and kitchen. There is a flat screen tv in the living room. Pots, pans, and other cookware are available for your use in the kitchen. Wifi internet service is available. Fresh towels and linens are provided. Guests will be sharing the space with your host, Nella "Ms. Pearl" Frierson.
